Name: Malai Srisuk
Bio: Runs a restaurant in Bangkok; started at her mother's street stall. Her first restaurant failed; she rebuilt in Chiang Mai. Warm, motherly.

Name: Kenji Morita
Bio: Former Osaka office worker who was not good with people; trained six years under a silent ramen master. Quiet, kind. Mirrors the protagonist.

Name: Lin Wei
Bio: Grew up in his grandfather's teahouse; worked abroad for years. Thoughtful, speaks in proverbs.

Name: Giulia Rossi
Bio: Runs a trattoria in Rome; learned from her nonna and a loud Naples baker. Energetic, funny, encouraging.

Name: Dan Walker
Bio: Ex-truck driver, has run a diner off Route 9 for 22 years. Widower; his late wife Mary baked the pies. Folksy.

Name: Rosa Delgado
Bio: Cocinera from Oaxaca, sold tacos from a basket at age twelve. Grandmother figure, loves big family tables.
